evidence: commit 1b3cc90 -- Task 13 (F9 closed: diagnosticSettings routed to LAW; Entra diagnostics moved to a documented G0 human step)
assertion.rationale: F9 (Task 13): resource-plane actions are traceable. The subscription Activity Log (layer-06-platform.yml) captures the caller identity behind every ARM create/update/delete in the estate (Administrative category); Key Vault diagnosticSettings captures AuditEvent (who read/wrote which secret, key, certificate); SQL auditSettings with isAzureMonitorTargetEnabled:true captures per-principal database activity; storage and CAE diagnosticSettings cover the rest of the Azure resource plane -- all landing in the same Log Analytics workspace platform/main.bicep wires. The directory/identity plane is traceable too, but by a human step, not a pipeline call: an automated az monitor diagnostic-settings create against the Microsoft.aadiam tenant resource was implemented and then deliberately removed from layer-06-platform.yml, because the Security Administrator role it requires is materially more standing tenant privilege than mls-github-deployer should carry -- Task 10 narrowed this exact SP's Graph permission specifically to shrink its blast radius (finding F8), and automating this would re-inflate that. docs/runbooks/g0-bootstrap.md Section C item 12 documents the exact command for whoever holds Security Administrator or Global Administrator to run once, after L6, so which human or workload identity authenticated, which Conditional Access policy evaluated, and which directory role assignment changed become traceable once that one human step has been run -- the same remedy shape as item 4 (the Fabric SP API toggle), a documented human action rather than pipeline automation, which this register does not treat as a lesser remedy. Traceability for what a principal did once inside Azure is automated; traceability for who that principal was at the directory layer is one documented command away. A prior pass downgraded this control's gapSeverity to medium for partial progress; reverted per 3.1.5.json's precedent that severity does not discount for partial progress. With every piece of F9 now remedied, this control closes. Checked: no other finding in compliance/findings/2026-08-26-prepublication-review.md cites 3.3.2.

recommendation: None outstanding for this control. Run docs/runbooks/g0-bootstrap.md Section C item 12 once, after the first L6 deploy, to put the Entra identity-plane logs into the same workspace the Azure resource-plane logs already land in. A regression in any diagnosticSettings block, the Activity Log step, or the G0 runbook item -- or granting mls-github-deployer Security Administrator to re-automate what item 12 documents -- would reopen this control.
